snippet.title: Project Damascus - Alpha Gameplay Trailer (WIP)
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM - Coming Soon™ to Early Access (2026) 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3929100/Project_Damascus/

This is a short gameplay trailer. All footage of the game is EXTREMELY non-final. That is to say, it's ALREADY changed a lot, and is subject to change a lot more between here and the game's Early Access release.

We'd love you to come on this journey through time with us. 

---------------------
SUPPORT US ON PATREON: https://www.patreon.com/cw/DamascusTeamGames

AGREGAR A LISTA DE DESEOS EN STEAM - Saldrá Pronto™ en Early Access (2026)

Este es un corto trailer de gameplay, todo lo grabado es EXTREMADAMENTE no-final. Es decir, YA HA CAMBIADO desde que se hizo este trailer, y de seguro cambiará mucho más entre ahora y el lanzamiento en Early Access.

Nos encataría que vengan en este viaje a través del tiempo con nosotros.
